articles.title: Delicacies next door: Bengaluru’s home kitchens fuel a hyperlocal food trend
articles.summary: Kolkata faces an urgent challenge regarding its fading architectural heritage. Numerous Rajbaris and palaces, once symbols of grandeur and historical significance, are decaying due to neglect and insufficient conservation efforts. The city risks losing these vital landmarks, which are integral to its rich cultural identity and India's historical narrative. Preserving these structures is crucial for safeguarding the past for future generations.

articles.title: 3rd body recovered a day after woman, toddler found dead in Kerala river; cops suspect family suicide
articles.summary: Three bodies, including a woman, a toddler, and a third individual, have been recovered from a Kerala river in Kochi. The initial discovery was made a day earlier when the woman and child were found. Police are investigating this tragic incident, with strong suspicions pointing towards a family suicide, highlighting a distressing event within the state.

articles.title: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Shramik Pravidhik Shiksha Sahaayata Yojana – Policy for All
articles.summary: Uttar Pradesh is advancing its education policy, highlighting the Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Shramik Pravidhik Shiksha Sahaayata Yojana. This scheme likely offers technical education assistance, aiming to empower workers and foster skill development for a robust workforce. It underscores the state's commitment to inclusive education and human resource development, crucial for national progress and productivity among SSB aspirants.

articles.title: In 1977, a team of American marine geologists in a small research submarine descended to the seafloor of the Galápagos Rift and discovered something no biology textbook on Earth had ever predicted — an entire thriving ecosystem of giant tube worms, ghostly white crabs, and microbial life sustained not by sunlight but by heat and chemicals leaking out of the planet’s interior
articles.summary: In 1977, the R/V Knorr research vessel, departing Panama, unexpectedly made a significant biological discovery. Despite no biologists initially onboard, as such finds weren't anticipated for the expedition's primary goal, this event likely revolutionized scientific understanding of marine life. It underscores the importance of exploration and serendipity in advancing knowledge, a crucial lesson for future scientific and strategic endeavors.

articles.title: Bank of India announces 779 Credit Officer vacancies, detailed notification due on June 30
articles.summary: Bank of India has announced 779 Credit Officer vacancies, presenting a significant opportunity for job seekers across the nation, including SSB aspirants exploring diverse career paths. The comprehensive notification detailing eligibility criteria, application process, and important dates for these positions is slated for release on June 30. Aspiring candidates should prepare to monitor official Bank of India channels for updates.

articles.title: hypercolor added to PyPI
articles.summary: This update details an Async Python client and WebSocket helpers package designed for the Hypercolor daemon. Operating as a standalone project within the main Hypercolor repository, it facilitates contributions from Python developers. This emphasizes ongoing advancements in software development and system integration, crucial for modern technological infrastructure and efficiency across various domains.

articles.title: UK left without nuclear attack subs at sea – media
articles.summary: The UK's entire fleet of nuclear-powered attack submarines is reportedly confined to port due to severe maintenance bottlenecks, as per the UK Defence Journal. This critical issue highlights significant challenges in the Royal Navy's operational readiness and submarine capability. Former officers have expressed serious concerns, pointing to potential vulnerabilities in national security and maritime defence postures during this period.

articles.title: Around 11-lakh families have received assistance totalling ₹22,000 crore under ‘PMJJBY’ scheme: PM
articles.summary: The Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) has enrolled over 27 crore people, providing vital life insurance coverage. Approximately 11 lakh families nationwide have received substantial financial assistance totaling around 22,000 crore under this crucial social security scheme. PMJJBY continues to demonstrate significant impact on citizens' welfare and financial security across India.

articles.title: Indian Air Force C-17s carry relief materials to earthquake-hit Venezuela via Abidjan under OP Amistad
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force's C-17 Globemaster aircraft recently transited through Abidjan, Cote d'Ivoire, while en route to provide crucial relief materials to earthquake-stricken Venezuela. This mission underscores India's commitment to global humanitarian assistance and showcases the IAF's strategic long-range airlift capabilities for international disaster response.
